spans.s: --a son of the first सावर्ण Manu. Br.
--a son of Damana, an अवतार् of the Lord in the third द्वापर. वा. २३. १२४.

--the ceremony usually done on the १२थ् day of one's death; after this the dead person becomes eligible for पार्वण and the गृहस्त becomes eligible for per- forming नान्दिश्राद्ध; in सपिण्डीकरण fresh invocation to the devas;
1: M. १८. १५-17; Vi. III. १३. २६.
leads up to the cleansing of the pollution.
2: M. १६. ५८.

(I)--the sons of ब्रह्मा who bear the गङ्गा in their locks; with the constellations traversing Maghas, com- menced the Kali age; when they move to पूर्वाषाढ, there began the reign of Nanda;
1: भा. V. १७. 3;
--of the सूर्यमण्डल in different months. Vi. II. १०. 1-१८.

--a R. visited by बलराम; fit for श्राद्ध offerings.
2: Br. III. १३. १९; M. २२. ७८; वा. ७७. १९.
^1 भा. X. ७९. १२.
--(शिल्प) the images of वाराह, नारसिम्ह and वामन. M. २५९. 2.
--a horse yoked to the moon's chariot. M. १२६. ५२.
--a व्रत taught by the Sun god to क्रितवीर्य of the Haihaya clan; sacred to Rudra; a प्रतिमा of धर्मराज given as gift to the guru is good for the children in a family. M. ६८. 3, १२-42.
--(of emperors); cakra, chariot, precious stones, consort, treasure, horses and elephants. वा. ५७. ६८.

. १३४.
burns down the three worlds in the pralaya.
2: वा. ६६. १२७.
--are ह्रीङ्कार Pran2ava, गीत, Pras- ताव, Pratihotra, Upadravam and निधानम्. Br. II. ३३. ३९.
--the hermitage in the हिमालयस् where धृतराष्ट्र spent his last days. भा. I. १३. ५१.
--the Sun God with seven rays emitting fire before the deluge.
--the seven births of जयादेवस् in different manvantaras having seven characteristics. वा. ६७. ४६-7.

--a gift; seven gold कुण्डस् (7 palas to 1,०००) with salt, milk, ghee, jaggery, curd, sugar and water with the respective deities, ब्रह्मा, केशव, महेश्- vara, भास्कर, निशाधिप, लक्ष्मी and पार्वती; the gift after वारुण homa; the giver attains शिवलोकम्. M. २७४. १०: २८
--the seven Suns, burning up the universe. वा. 7. ५२.
--of वायु where live the seven गणस्. वा. 2. ४०.
--the seven limbs of a kingdom; स्वामि, अमात्य, janapada, durga, दण्ड, कोश and mitra. M. २२०. १९.

--mantra to be recited at the श्राद्ध; leads to overlordship;
1: Br. III. ११. २२-33.
to be recited daily in honour of पितृस् and their seven गणस्; in nine verses.
2: वा. ७४. २०-29.
